records.question: 各品类商品销售额（不含运费）前十名是哪些？
records.sql_text: SELECT p.product_category AS product_category, SUM(oi.price) AS item_gmv FROM v_o_order_items AS oi JOIN v_o_orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN v_o_products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND p.product_category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_category ORDER BY item_gmv DESC LIMIT 10

detail.binding_disclosure: 商品金额取明细行 price，不含运费

gold.gold_sql:
SELECT pr.product_category AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS item_gmv
FROM v_o_order_items AS i
JOIN v_o_orders AS o   ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN v_o_products AS pr ON pr.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY pr.product_category
ORDER BY item_gmv DESC
LIMIT 10
